[SWS_PHM_00233] Switch Global Supervision Status from kEXPIRED to kOK
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kEXPIRED, the Elementary Su-
pervision Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is kOK and
no supervision is in Elementary Supervision Status kFAILED or kEXPIRED,
then the Platform Health Management shall change the Global Supervision
Status to kOK.
⌋
